turns.utterance: Who sang still crazy after all these years?

gold_passages: "Still Crazy After All These Years" is a song by the American singer-songwriter Paul Simon.

Still Crazy After All These Years is the fourth solo studio album by Paul Simon. Recorded and released in 1975, the album produced four U.S. Top 40 hits: "50 Ways to Leave Your Lover" (#1), "Gone at Last" (#23), "My Little Town" (#9, credited to Simon & Garfunkel), and the title track (#40).
